name: thruk_list_hosts
description: List monitored hosts with optional filters (hostgroup, state, name_regex, columns).

name: thruk_get_host
description: Get a single host by name.

name: thruk_list_services
description: List monitored services with optional filters (host, servicegroup, state, description_regex).

name: thruk_get_service
description: Get a single service by host and description.

name: thruk_problems
description: List all current unhandled host and service problems.

name: thruk_query
description: Escape hatch: call any Thruk REST endpoint with method, params, body.

name: thruk_schedule_downtime
description: Schedule a downtime on a host or service.

name: thruk_delete_downtime
description: Delete a host or service downtime by id.

name: thruk_acknowledge
description: Acknowledge a host or service problem.

name: thruk_remove_acknowledgement
description: Remove an acknowledgement from a host or service.

name: thruk_recheck
description: Schedule an immediate (forced) check for a host or service.
